en-US.description: Local AI video watermark remover — repaints watermarks, subtitles and logos instead of blurring them.
en-US.longDescription:
Alethon is a local AI watermark remover for video and images. It removes watermarks,
subtitles, station logos and unwanted objects, then repaints the area with an inpainting
model rather than blurring or pixelating it. Everything runs on your own machine —
no footage is uploaded to any server.

What sets it apart: no blur smear (the model reconstructs the hidden content so it
matches surrounding texture); hover-to-highlight selection instead of hand-painted masks;
per-shot tracks, so a watermark that moves after a cut is handled segment by segment
and you only re-run the segments you dislike. Images work the same way.

Engines: standard photo inpainting (bundled with the installer, ready on first launch),
anime inpainting, temporally stable video inpainting, plus optional super-resolution.

Honest note: repainted pixels are generated by AI, not the real content hidden underneath.
Use it only on footage you have the rights to; do not use it to strip other people's
copyrighted watermarks or to circumvent content protection.
en-US.name: Alethon Video Watermark Remover

zh-CN.description: 本地运行的 AI 视频去水印工具，把水印、字幕、台标整块重画掉，不是打码抹糊。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Alethon 是一款本地运行的 AI 视频去水印工具。它能识别并移除画面里的水印、字幕、
台标 logo 以及路人杂物，然后用 AI 把这块区域重新画出来，而不是简单打码或高斯模糊。
处理全程在本机完成，画面不上传任何服务器。

与普通去水印工具的区别：不靠模糊涂抹，模型会把被遮挡的画面补出来，接得上周围纹理；
挑选不用手涂，鼠标停在目标上就高亮，点一下选中；按镜头分段，切镜后水印换位置也各管各的，
哪段不满意只重跑哪段；图片同样适用。

多种消除引擎：标准照片修复（随安装包附带，装完即用）、动漫画面修复、稳定视频修复
（跨帧一致、不闪烁），以及可选的高清补画增强。

诚实声明：重画出来的像素是 AI 算出来的，不是原片里真实存在的内容。请在合法、
且拥有相应权利的素材上使用，勿用于去除他人享有版权的水印或规避内容保护。
zh-CN.name: Alethon 视频去水印 物体移除
